## Summary

Describe the change and its intended outcome.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited to the approved work.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `pnpm ci:verify` passes locally where practical.
- [ ] Security implications and environment-variable changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Accessibility was considered; screenshots are attached for meaningful UI changes.
- [ ] Database migrations are included or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and operational instructions are updated.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and known risks are recorded.
